svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1198 commits across five public projects, 67 active days, peak 126 commits per day. 2026-09-02 through 2026-11-24 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-24T00:08:43.429Z.
